시편 29:1.content: A Psalm of David. Give unto the Lord, O ye mighty, give unto the Lord glory and strength.

시편 29:2.content: Give unto the Lord the glory due unto his name; worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness.

시편 29:3.content: The voice of the Lord is upon the waters: the God of glory thundereth: the Lord is upon many waters.

시편 29:4.content: The voice of the Lord is powerful; the voice of the Lord is full of majesty.

시편 29:5.content: The voice of the Lord breaketh the cedars; yea, the Lord breaketh the cedars of Lebanon.

시편 29:6.content: He maketh them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young unicorn.

시편 29:7.content: The voice of the Lord divideth the flames of fire.

시편 29:8.content: The voice of the Lord shaketh the wilderness; the Lord shaketh the wilderness of Kadesh.

시편 29:9.content: The voice of the Lord maketh the hinds to calve, and discovereth the forests: and in his temple doth every one speak of his glory.

시편 29:10.content: The Lord sitteth upon the flood; yea, the Lord sitteth King for ever.

시편 29:11.content: The Lord will give strength unto his people; the Lord will bless his people with peace.
